metaDescription: Order custom 13 oz koozies for your brand. Perfect for cans and bottles. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 13 oz koozies offer a snug fit for standard beverage cans while providing superior insulation. Unlike universal sizes, the 13 oz capacity ensures your drink stays cold longer without slipping. Ideal for corporate events, trade shows, or employee gifts, these koozies can be decorated with screen printing or full-color wraps. The KOOZIE® Triple Vacuum Tumbler exemplifies the quality available in this size range, making your logo stand out during every use.
heroAltText: Custom 13 oz koozies with a branded design featuring a vacuum-insulated tumbler in a corporate setting.
